scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Player
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: Grandma, are you okay? You've been staring at that photo for a while.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: I just want to go back. One more kauli, before... before I get too old to travel.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Player
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: Then let's go. Talk to Dad.

choices.label: I'll help you plan it, Grandma. We're really going.
I don't really know much about Aklan, but fine, let's try.
Isn't that too far? You might have a hard time, Grandma.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: Saeamat, Apo. This old heart needed to hear that.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: That's alright. You'll learn — the language will teach you where you're from.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: Maybe. But some things are worth being tired for.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: Let's call your father. We need to book the flights now.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Papa Jobert
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Wow, this place doesn't change. Same humidity as I remember, huh, Ma.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Player
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Grandma, teach me that. I want to say it right when we meet Aunt Susan.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Just follow along. mayad nga agahon.

choices.label: Mayad nga agahon! Did I say it right, Grandma?
Mayad nga agahon? I'll practice more.
This is going to take forever, I don't think I can do this.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Almost! You're closer than you think, Apo.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Practice makes it stick. We have time.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Don't rush yourself, Apo. Even I forgot some words — and this is my home.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Kamusta ka? — that one is easy, you already know it from Tagalog.
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.translation: How are you? — same line, spoken to greet.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Papa Jobert
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Come on, Aunt Susan is outside already. Let's not keep her waiting.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.translation: Jonabel! Where have you been, sister?!

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: (mumbles) So this is the balikbayan cousin, huh.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Rose! I told you, introduce yourself. This is Jonabel's grandchild — you'll help her learn Akeanon, okay?

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: (sighs) Fine. But don't expect me to go easy just because you flew in from abroad.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Player
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: I mean... I did fly like 14 hours, so a little easy would be nice.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: 14 hours doesn't teach you a language. I do. Deal's a deal, Aunt Susan.

choices.label: Deal. Teach me everything, I'm serious about this.
We'll see how it goes. No promises I'll be good at it.
I don't even know if I need this, honestly.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Good. Don't waste my time then, balikbayan.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Fair enough. Effort matters more than talent anyway.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Then why'd you come? ...whatever. Your loss if you don't try.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Sunod kamo. I'll show you the town.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Okay, quick drill before we go home. Focus, balikbayan.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Okay, ako... ikaw... siya. Got it, I think.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Kami — "we," but not you. Kita — "we," and that includes you. Kamo — "you all." Sanda — "they."
Are you ready for the next?

choices.label: Yes, keep going. I want to actually remember these.
Give me a second, it's already too many at once.
Can we save the rest for later, Rose? My brain hurts.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: That's what I like to hear. Fine, one more batch.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Fair. Take your time, we've got a walk ahead anyway.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Ugh, fine. But we're picking this up again tomorrow.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Amay — "father." Nanay — "mother." Bata — "child." Easy ones, you'll hear these a lot.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Isa, daywa, tatlo, apat, lima — count with me. Point at each one.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Isa, daywa, tatlo, apat, lima. Hey, that wasn't so bad.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: See? Told you. Baby steps, balikbayan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Kadugay ko na di nakatilaw sang kan-on nga tumbien sa balay ni Susan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Player, do not forget to write to your Lola back home too. Distance should never mean silence.
Napahiling si Lola Jonabel sa bintana, nakangiti nang walang partikular na dahilan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Kung pagod ka na, Apo, sabihin mo lang. Hindi kailangan lahat ngayon din matutunan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: This town raised me before it raised your Tita Susan. Funny how it still feels the same.
Hinihipo ni Lola Jonabel ang lumang litrato sa kanyang bag, hindi napapansin na napapangiti siya.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Marami pang lugar dito na gusto kong ipakita sa'yo, Apo. Isa-isa lang.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Alam mo, kahit gaano man katagal, parang kailan lang 'yong huling beses ko dito.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Grabe 'to, parang bata ulit ako pag nandito. Sobrang dami ng memories, anak.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Huwag kang mag-alala kay Rose, ganyan talaga siya. Marunong naman siya magturo, promise.
Kinukuha ni Papa Jobert ang kanyang phone, kunwari kukuha ng litrato pero halatang nostalgic lang.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Alam mo, dito rin ako natutong mag-Akeanon dati. Parang paulit-ulit lang 'yung kwento, ha.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Sabihin mo kay Lola kung kailan ka na-tire. Alam mo naman siya, hindi siya titigil sa excitement.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Sobrang saya ni Lola ngayon, no? Sulit lahat ng jetlag para diyan.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Kung may makalimutan tayo, ako na bahala. Ikaw, focus ka lang sa pag-aaral.
Napapatango-tango si Papa Jobert habang naglalakad, parang bawat kanto may kwento.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Halong, apo — mainit gid diri sa Aklan, indi pareho sa America.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Kung gutom ka, sabihon mo lang. Damo pagkaon sa balay.
Ngumiti si Lola Susan, hinahaplos ang balikat ni Jonabel na parang natatakot pang mawala ulit ito.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Rose is a good girl, ha. Sharp lidah lang — sharp tongue. Her heart is bigger than that mouth.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Sabihin mo sa akin kung ano pa gusto mong makita dito. Ipapakita ko lahat.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Dati pa, magkasama kami ni Jonabel sa lahat. Ngayon, ikaw naman ang kasama niya.
Kinukuha ni Lola Susan ang bag ni Player nang hindi man lang pinapayagan siyang tumanggi.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Indi ka gid mabudlayan diri, Apo. Kilala ka namon tanan.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag mo akong tignan nang ganyan, hindi ako tour guide. ...okay, konti lang.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka gid, ha. Indi lang basta-basta.
Tumingin si Rose sa Player nang matagal, parang sinusukat kung seryoso ba talaga siya.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: My Lola Susan talks about your Lola Jonabel parang superhero pa. Big shoes to fill, balikbayan.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Fine, you're not completely hopeless. ...don't let that get to your head.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Alam mo, hindi ko rin naman gustong magturo dati. Pero, sige na nga.
Napailing si Rose, pero halatang pigil ang ngiti.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag kang mag-expect ng slack sa 'kin kasi pinsan ka daw ni Tita Susan. Rules apply to everyone.
